climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A cool AVA in southern Santa Clara County, east of Gilroy, inside the Santa Clara Valley. Breezes come up the Pajaro River. It was set up around two vineyards, Mistral and San Ysidro, with about 520 acres under vine.
